convergence_alert.rule: Alerts require converging signals and at least 7 historical observations per metric. HRV/sleep/resting/night HR use fused recovery history; stress/body battery/recovery time retain Advanced Analytics sources. Thresholds are unchanged and isolated changes are not diagnostic.
convergence_alert.aggregation_rule: Severity is based on independent physiological domains, not raw metric count. Sleep duration + sleep score count once; resting HR + night HR count once; stress + Body Battery count once. Signal thresholds are unchanged.

weekly_load.note: Monotony/strain are contextual training-load descriptors, not medical thresholds.

personal_calibration.note: Personal calibration learns associations with next-day recovery cost. It remains descriptive, not diagnostic, and is not allowed to override data-quality guardrails.

interpretation_rules.hybrid_readiness: LOW local confidence: 70% Garmin + 30% local; MEDIUM: 55% Garmin + 45% local; HIGH: 40% Garmin + 60% local. Garmin <50/LOW/POOR or Recovery Time >=24 h prevents green; Garmin <35 forces red.
interpretation_rules.robust_z: Uses historical median/MAD excluding the current day when available to reduce distortion from outliers.
interpretation_rules.alerts: Require converging signals and at least 7 historical observations per baseline metric; no single metric is diagnostic.
interpretation_rules.hrr: HRR1 uses Intervals.icu icu_hrr when available. HRR2/3/5 are reported only if the activity stream actually contains those time points.
interpretation_rules.load: Work-output fields are proxies; Garmin/Intervals training load, TRIMP and sRPE are internal-load measures and are not double-counted as external work.

rpe_feedback.policy: Intervals RPE has priority when present; external feedback fills missing RPE. Differences >=0.5 are reported.

recovery_assessment_v2.recommendation: Interpretar junto con dolor, sensaciones, RPE y rendimiento; no es un diagnóstico.
limitations: No suma valores Garmin + Intervals del mismo día.

sleep_integrity.policy: Body Battery sleep events are candidates only; never add to confirmed Garmin sleep.

sleep_score_provenance.policy: Use the confirmed sleep-detail score for the recovery model, not the training-readiness component.

v23.note: V2.3.1 reliability overlay; the V2.2 baseline score is retained unless invalid measurements or a restrictive private guardrail block clearance.

measurement_provenance.note: Measurement timestamps are independent from file generation times. Nightly HRV is expected during sleep, not continuously.

sleep_fragmentation.note: User-confirmed extra naps may inform discussion but are not merged with Garmin HRV, stages or sleep-score baselines.

training_guidance.note: Guidance only; no direct measure of neuromuscular readiness, and sleepiness can affect coordination independently of muscle fatigue.

recovery_baseline_policy.note: Recovery-sensitive signals still use fused history with the same thresholds, but convergence severity is now based on independent domains so correlated metrics are not double-counted. Recovery Score and Hybrid Readiness scoring are unchanged.
